methodology.area: Local planar UTM projection derived dynamically per chip via geopandas.estimate_utm_crs()
methodology.population: Fractional WorldPop aggregation (10m flood fraction inside 100m grid cell x cell population)
methodology.roads: Geometric line-in-polygon intersection in planar metric UTM space via local Geofabrik shapefile
assumptions: Population is distributed uniformly within each 100m x 100m WorldPop grid cell.
Label -1 (ignore) pixels are treated as not-flood for exposure bounds.
Thresholds p>0.70 (conservative), p>0.50 (expected), p>0.30 (worst-case) are fixed a priori.

notes: Thresholds give an operational sensitivity range, not a statistical confidence interval. WorldPop year is 2018 whereas event year is 2018. Roads were evaluated using official local Geofabrik shapefile extracts (offline); missing roads in a chip indicate that no road features exist within that specific chip bounding box in the extract (distinct from mapped roads that remain unflooded). Small sample size caveat applies (15 chips evaluated).
